name: scribble
description: Capture app screens, annotate them, and hand precise visual feedback to your coding agent.

interface.shortDescription: Visual feedback for your coding agent
interface.longDescription: Capture local webpages and iOS simulators, annotate screenshots, and send feedback from an embedded canvas. Requires Node.js 22+ and a desktop host with local MCP support. The standalone browser editor remains available.
defaultPrompt: Open Scribble so I can give visual feedback on this project.
